description: This file handles HTTP error processing in a web server, including rendering error pages, converting errors to HTTP responses, handling form errors, and binding errors with detailed context messages.

methods.name: error_to_html_string
methods.description: Converts an error into an HTML string for display, using templates and including backtrace info if not in production.

methods.name: anyhow_err_to_actix_resp
methods.description: Converts an error into an Actix-web HTTP response, setting appropriate status and headers.

methods.name: send_anyhow_error
methods.description: Sends an error response asynchronously via a oneshot channel.

methods.name: anyhow_err_to_actix
methods.description: Converts an error into an Actix-web error type, wrapping the response.

methods.name: handle_form_error
methods.description: Handles URL-encoded form errors, returning appropriate Actix-web errors.

methods.name: bind_error
methods.description: Creates a detailed error message for binding failures, with context based on error kind.
